$comment: Control register for registration readiness. Each control has an objective, an owner, a test frequency, and a failure response, and links to evidence in evidence-registry.json. This register covers access, source freshness, and workflow integrity. Audit, privacy, accessibility, and incident-response controls are not yet written. Validated by app/src/lib/governance/readiness-governance.test.ts.

controls.name: Tenant and subject isolation
controls.objective: An actor can read or write only records allowed by tenant, role, grant, record scope, and institutional policy.

controls.name: Stale-source disclosure
controls.objective: Semester does not show a definitive readiness result when authoritative input exceeds the agreed freshness threshold.

controls.name: Controlled routing and overrides
controls.objective: A staff member cannot silently alter an official outcome or approve their own exceptional-action request.
